display.title: Lag BaOmer: Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai and the Greatest Blessing
display.summary_short: On Lag BaOmer, Jews pray at Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai's resting place in Meron; Uncle Yossi explains why the coming of Moshiach is the blessing that includes all others.
display.summary_long: A Lag BaOmer talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi explains that Lag BaOmer, the 33rd day of the Omer, is the yahrzeit of the holy Tanna Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai. People come from all over the world to his resting place in Meron, in the Galil, where many other tzaddikim are also buried, to pray to Hashem for all their needs. In this year of wonders, he says, we pray for the greatest blessing of all, one that includes every other blessing: that Moshiach should come now. Then the sick will be healed, all nations will live in peace, the battle with the yetzer hara will end in victory and Hashem will remove all evil. Eliyahu HaNavi will announce Moshiach, the third Beis HaMikdash will come down from Heaven before the eyes of the world, and tzaddikim such as Avraham, Yitzchak, Yaakov, Moshe Rabbeinu and Aharon HaKohen will live again.
display.lesson: The coming of Moshiach is the blessing that includes all others, and we pray for it with full trust.

date.note: Cut from episode 478, broadcast just after Lag BaOmer 5751 (candle times fit Friday 10 May 1991).
